crossRefs.note: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is…
Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of…
as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to…
He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise…
Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities…
One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world…
Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of…
redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

translations.web: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.
translations.bsb: Divide your portion among seven, or even eight, for you do not know what disaster may befall the land.
translations.kjv: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
translations.asv: Give a portion to seven, yea, even unto eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
